codeSamples.code:
<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/throttle-schedule';
$ch = curl_init();

$baseUrl =  $baseUrl . '?FromStartDate=String&ToStartDate=String&FromCreatedDate=String&ToCreatedDate=String&Status=String&Msisdns=Array&Channel=String&OrderBy=String&OrderDir=String&PageNumber=Integer&PageSize=Integer';

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'AccountReference' => 'your-AccountReference-header-here',
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}
?>

sections.title: Api overview
sections.content:
This guide explains how to retrieve all Throttle Schedules, add additional filtering on all the throttled schedules by adding a query parameter for FromStartDate, ToStartDate, FromCreatedDate, ToCreatedDate, Status, Msisdns and more

Before you start your implementation, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites in our Introduction documentation.

sections.title: Required Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorisation
AccountReferenceStringYour Esendex account reference - e.g. SPNL000000


Example request header:
GET https://api.spryng.nl/v2/throttle-schedule
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'AccountReference: SPNL000000'


Query parameters

The below parameters are available as optional filters to your request. They should be provided as a query within the request path.


PropertyTypeDescription
FromStartDateStringFilter all the throttled schedules from a certain date. If both FromStartDate and ToStartDate are provided then throttled sends starting between the dates will be returned. Date must be provided in YYYY-MM-DD format
ToStartDateStringFilter all throttled schedules until the start date provided. If both FromStartDate and ToStartDate are provided then throttled sends starting between the dates will be returned. Date must be provided in YYYY-MM-DD format
FromCreatedDateStringFilter all throttled schedules from the created date provided. If both FromCreatedDate and ToCreatedDate are provided then throttled sends starting between the dates will be returned. Date must be provided in YYYY-MM-DD format
ToCreatedDateStringFilter all throttled schedules until the created date provided. If both FromCreatedDate and ToCreatedDate are provided then throttled sends starting between the dates will be returned. Date must be provided in YYYY-MM-DD format
StatusStringFilter by the status of the throttled schedules. Available options are: Active | Paused | Cancelled | Failed | Completed | PartiallyCompleted
msisdnStringThe phone number that received the outbound message. Must use international format e.g. 447xxxxxxxxx. This lets you filter for all messages to an MSISDN
PageSizeStringPagination required for the response. Allow 1-1000. Default = 1
PageNumberStringNumber of pages for the response. Allow 1+. Default = 1
OrderDirQuerySets the sorting direction. Default = descending. Available values: Asc & Desc
